headline: Cabo Verde Annual Inflation Accelerates to 4.3% in October
summary: National statistics agency INE reported that Cabo Verde's year-on-year consumer price inflation climbed to 4.3% in October from 2.7% in September, while the 12-month average inflation rate stood at 1.8%.
why: Cabo Verde pegs its currency to the euro and depends heavily on tourism and commodity imports, making domestic inflation vulnerable to external supply shifts.

impacts.name: Cabo Verde
impacts.why: A sharp rise in headline inflation increases household living costs and tightens domestic economic conditions.
